# Function: slugify()

> **slugify**(`text`, `options?`): `string`

Turns text into a URL-friendly slug.

## Parameters

### text

`string`

the text to convert

### options?

[`SlugOptions`](../interfaces/SlugOptions.md) = `{}`

how to convert it

## Returns

`string`

the slug

## Throws

Error when `text` is empty
